opener_rules.must_state: the implication of the signal (what it costs or risks), not the signal alone

banned_phrases: let me know if you're interested
ai_tells_for_critic: three stacked adjectives or a rule-of-three list with no specifics
rhetorical question immediately answered by the writer
generic industry claim with no number, name, or specific
every sentence the same length and rhythm

no_oriented: Would it be a bad idea to {small_action}?
Is it a terrible idea to {small_action}?
negative_reverse: Worth a look, or is {thing} already set?
Is {topic} on the list this year, or parked for later?
Is this on your radar, or am I off base?
offer: Want the one workflow we'd start with?
Should I send the scorecard we'd use for {company}?
limited_choice: Should I send the other two, or walk you through them in 20 minutes?
Easier to read it, or see it scored live?
breakup: Have you given up on {outcome} this year?
Should I close this out, or is {topic} a Q1 thing?
banned_ctas: Can we hop on a call
Would you be open to a call

honesty_rules: Every factual claim about the prospect must cite a dossier fact_id.
Every claim about Nine-67 results must come from approved_proof_lines.
No fake Re:/Fwd: subjects, invented referrals, false deadlines, or scarcity.
Hedge inferences with 'usually', 'often', 'tends to'. Never state an inference as a fact about them.
approved_proof_lines: TODO: only results cleared for use. Example shape: 'We run the AI operating layer inside a national agency.'
nine67_differentiators: Engineers deployed inside the business, not slideware
Working agents shipped in weeks, not a strategy deck
Every workflow gets a number attached before we build it

persona_value_drivers.coo: throughput and capacity without adding headcount
persona_value_drivers.cio_cto: shipping AI that works in production, governed and secure
persona_value_drivers.pe_operating_partner: EBITDA lift inside the hold period, repeatable across the portfolio
persona_value_drivers.vp_ops: cycle time and error rates on core workflows
persona_value_drivers.vp_sales_revops: pipeline and proposal throughput per rep
